requirements.title: Typed execution is supervised by the managed Playwright driver
requirements.description: The execution path uses the managed Playwright driver and lifecycle supervision for typed workflows.

validation.notes: Covered by BAS driver, execution, and monetization conformance suites.

requirements.title: Validation evidence is persisted with integrity metadata
requirements.description: Replay and validation evidence is retained with integrity metadata and exercised through Test Genie.

validation.notes: Covered by BAS replay, Test Genie, and monetization conformance suites.

requirements.title: Product boundaries remain maintainable and governed
requirements.description: UI, API, storage, driver, and proto boundaries remain documented, testable, and governed.

validation.notes: Covered by BAS architecture, contracts, and shared monetization kit checks.

requirements.title: Tenant controls are required before public multi-tenant deployment
requirements.description: Authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, retention, capacity, and service-level controls remain launch prerequisites.

validation.notes: The PRD explicitly keeps public multi-tenant deployment gated on these controls.

requirements.title: Validated workflows can produce repeatable demonstration evidence
requirements.description: Validated replay artifacts support repeatable evidence-backed demonstration production.

validation.notes: Covered by the generated-app and desktop trust-boundary journeys.

requirements.title: Commercial automation controls remain evidence-gated
requirements.description: Commercial automation capabilities remain gated on the operational controls and evidence required for productization.

validation.notes: The PRD explicitly gates commercial productization on operational controls and evidence.
